deviations.what: h26's config_digest clause cannot hold on a bare run: config_digest is the change-content lifecycle's EVENT-stream digest (configlifecycle/configevents), absent from every bare artifact (test_e2e_mock pins its key set without it), and EngineConfig.to_dict() reaches only config show/telemetry, never the artifact. t4 therefore attests both knobs via (a) config show --json (hire, acting_add_tools — always present) and (b) the EngineConfig snapshot (omit-when-unset keys), and the ARTIFACT-side attestation is t2's offered_tools (the add-set shows up as offered names now; the hire pair once t10 lands). h26's wording 'two artifacts differing only in COLLEAGUE_HIRE differ in config_digest' should read '...differ in offered_tools'.
deviations.reason: discovered while implementing t4: the digest named in h26 does not exist on the artifacts the arm rows read

deviations.what: Operator decision 2026-08-30 (mid-t6): the scout/code_survey seat is intended to be the associate role (nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4), but the rig advertises it ready:false and the session does not consume it, so every purpose child in the 9-run matrix runs on cortex (Qwen3.8-27B) — exactly as rows 60/61 pre-registered. Decision: FINISH the 9 runs as-is AND ADD a nemotron arm — 3 extra runs with the associate armed (COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_MODEL=lobes) once the role is ready, pre-registered as row 62 (the hire arm moves to row 63), giving scout-seat statistics without invalidating the matrix; the overlay for that arm must be the one whose seat description is TRUE for nemotron (P0's 'quicker seat, reasoning off'), so it is a SEAT comparison against row 60, never a prose comparison.
deviations.reason: operator: 'scout (code_survey) is nemotron 3.5 lightning' — the intended topology differs from what the rig served

deviations.what: Operator decision 2026-08-30: nemotron (the lobes associate role) as the NON-WRITER seat — code_survey, web_survey and the other read-only purpose children — should be ON BY DEFAULT, not opt-in. This amends the qwen-direct convention change (5): associate discovery stays a fixed resolution rung (a READY advertised associate role fills the scout/read-only purpose seats; absent or not-ready = a RECORDED cortex fallback, byte-identical; COLLEAGUE_ASSOCIATE_MODEL=off opts out) — the deepthink-from-muse precedent (sanctioned increment 6), never a router. The writer purpose (handover_to_colleague) and the acting seat stay on cortex. Lands as new plan task t19 in Phase A before the nemotron arm (row 62) so that arm measures the shipped default.
deviations.reason: operator: 'nemotron as the non-writer (code-survey, web-survey, etc.) should be on by default'
